pitch.heading: Grow Your Brand In The Ring
pitch.body: Heavy Hitters Promotions puts your brand in front of a passionate, growing fight community — from fight night energy to year-round digital reach. Whether you're looking for regional visibility or a marquee event partnership, we'll build a package that fits your goals.

offerings.title: Ring Banner
offerings.description: Prime ringside visibility — seen by every camera angle and every seat in the house all night long.

offerings.title: Fighter Walkout
offerings.description: Your brand featured in the entrance video and walkout for one of our fighters.

offerings.title: VIP Suite Branding
offerings.description: A branded hospitality space to host your top clients and prospects fight night.

offerings.title: Broadcast Graphics
offerings.description: On-screen logo placement during the livestream broadcast and post-fight replays.

offerings.title: Social Media Takeover
offerings.description: Dedicated posts and stories across our event social channels in the lead-up to fight night.

offerings.title: Title Naming Rights
offerings.description: The event presented by your brand, front and center on every piece of promotion.

packages.name: Center Canvas Logo
benefits: Top-center canvas placement — the single most visible spot in the ring
Featured in every broadcast camera angle and photo

packages.name: Canvas Branding Around Center
benefits: Canvas placement surrounding the center logo

packages.name: Ring Skirt Branding
benefits: Branding around the ring skirt, visible from every seat and camera angle

packages.name: Rope Branding
benefits: Logo placement on the ring ropes, in frame for every knockdown and clinch

packages.name: Ring Post Branding
benefits: Branding on the ring corner posts, prominent in wide broadcast shots

packages.name: Corner Pad Branding
benefits: Branded corner pads seen during every corner break between rounds

packages.name: Ringside Table Branding
benefits: Branding at the ringside table, in frame for commentary and broadcast coverage

packages.name: Presenting Partner
benefits: Prominent association with and top-level visibility throughout the Fighting For A Cause event
Featured across the full promotional campaign

packages.name: Championship Partner
benefits: Strong brand visibility and association with the championship event

packages.name: VIP Tables
benefits: Ideal for corporate entertainment, client engagement, employee recognition, and networking

customPartnerships.heading: Customized Sponsorships & Partnerships
customPartnerships.body: Interested in something tailored to your brand and objectives? These areas are open for a customized sponsorship or partnership — contact us to discuss what fits.
